name: spad_lambda_ng
label: next-gen SPAD Lambda (correlator readout)
notes: Next-generation design assumed for the R ~ 5000 studies: the same SPAD pixel performance with no rate ceiling between photon detection and the coincidence histogram (a real-time correlator), so the rate is limited only by dead time. An idealization: no such multi-channel system exists yet at >= 1e9 cps.
